name: Kettlebell Incline Shrug
cardText:
Kettlebell Incline Shrug
Beginner
1
Leaning across the back section of the bench, with feet firmly on the floor and with arms hanging to the sides.
2
Holding the kettlebell in both hands engage your shoulder blades, as if you are trying to touch them together. Release the shrug.

name: Kettlebell Silverback Shrug (Single)
cardText:
Kettlebell Silverback Shrug (Single)
Beginner
1
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
2
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
3
Holding the kettlebell in both hands engage your shoulder blades, as if you are trying to touch them together. Release the shrug.

name: Kettlebell Upright Row
cardText:
Kettlebell Upright Row
Novice
1
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
2
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
3
Lift the kettlebell upwards towards your chest and lower - repeat.

name: Kettlebell Shrug (Single)
cardText:
Kettlebell Shrug (Single)
Novice
1
Standing up straight with feet shoulder width apart.
2
Holding the kettlebell in both hands in front of your pelvis, engage your shoulder blades, as if you are trying to touch them together.
3
Release the shrug and repeat

name: Kettlebell Shrug
cardText:
Kettlebell Shrug
Novice
1
Stand with feet hip-width apart, hold one kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
2
Lift your shoulders upward while keeping arms straight.
3
Lower shoulders back down, repeat for desired reps.

name: Swing To Upright Row
cardText:
Swing To Upright Row
Intermediate
1
Start with a kettlebell between your legs, hinge at hips, swing it upward.
2
Lift kettlebell to chest level, elbows high, engaging shoulders.
3
Lower kettlebell back down, maintaining control. Repeat for desired reps.

name: Kettlebell Upright Row Single
cardText:
Kettlebell Upright Row Single
Beginner
1
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
2
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
3
Lift the kettlebell upwards towards your chest and lower - repeat.
